basic_details.job_title: DHS Ramgarh Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 32 Staff Nurse, Pharmacist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Health Society (Zila Swasthya Samiti), Ramgarh, is filling 32 contract vacancies under the National Health Mission, Jharkhand, through Advertisement No. 01/2026(DHS). The posts include Staff Nurse (GNM), ANM (Backlog), Lab Technician, Block Data Manager, Pharmacist and others, some with a backlog. The complete application in the prescribed form must be sent by registered post or speed post to the Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Officer, (Chhattarmandu) Ramgarh-825101, and must reach by 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026. Only local residents of Jharkhand are eligible.

content_sections.heading: About DHS Ramgarh
content_sections.text: District Health Society, Ramgarh, is the district-level health society that runs National Health Mission, Jharkhand programmes in Ramgarh district. This recruitment fills contract posts under the National Urban Health Mission (NUHM), the New Born Stabilization Unit (NBSU), the National Mental Health Programme (NCD), RNTCP, NHM, Rashtriya Bal Surksha Karyakram (RBSK), the Malnutrition Treatment Centre (MTC) and SNCU. The notice is issued by the Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Officer, Ramgarh.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only by registered post or speed post. Fill the prescribed application form ("Prescribed Form for Application") printed at the end of the notice and send it in a sealed envelope to this address: Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Officer, (Chhattarmandu) Ramgarh-825101 The application must reach the office by 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026. Applications sent directly or by registered post to any office other than the office of the Civil Surgeon, Ramgarh, will be rejected automatically. The envelope must clearly show the following details, otherwise the application will not be opened: The fee is paid by demand draft, attached to the application. The draft must be payable in the name of "District Health Society" (Zila Swasthya Samiti), Ramgarh. The application form asks for the D.D. number, date of issue and the bank and branch it was drawn from. A candidate applying for more than one post must send a separate application for each post, with the fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the required mark sheets and certificates. Residential certificate for claiming reservation. Caste certificate (the form asks for a self-attested copy of an up-to-date certificate issued by the competent authority). Matriculation certificate as proof of date of birth, with all educational qualification certificates. Two self-attested passport size photographs; the form also asks for a self-attested photo pasted on the form. For technical posts: self-attested copies of year-wise mark sheets (first, second and third year, as applicable), with the year-wise marks entered in the form. CGPA conversion chart with the mark sheet, for candidates giving a CGPA score. Disability certificate issued at the Civil Surgeon level (self-attested copy), for candidates with disabilities. Demand draft for the application fee. Indemnity Bond stating that the candidate will not claim regular appointment. A plain envelope with a Rs. 25/- postage stamp, bearing the correspondence address.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted by the committee on the basis of the advertised qualification will go on to the further selection process. Selection will be made on the basis of marks obtained in academic and technical examinations / Written Test / Skill Test / Interview, one or more of these, as applicable. The final merit list will be published for one week in the office of the Civil Surgeon/Deputy Commissioner. Information about the publication of the merit list on the notice board will be given through newspapers. The committee's decision in the appointment process will be final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DHS Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 32 contract vacancies, including 7 Staff Nurse (GNM) posts across NUHM, NBSU and NHM, 4 NCD - Multi Rehabilitation Worker posts and 2 GNM posts under SNCU.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DHS Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office of the Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Officer, Ramgarh by 05:00 PM on 27 November 2026; applications received after that will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Staff Nurse (GNM) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need 10+2 or Intermediate with 03 Years of GNM and Midwifery Training from a Government recognized Institution and registration under the Jharkhand State Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for DHS Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum is 35 years for Unreserved, 37 for BC/EBC, 38 for Women (Unreserved)/EWS/BC/EBC, 40 for SC/ST and 35 for EWS, with higher limits (45 to 50 years) for persons with disabilities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for DHS Ramgarh posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs. 10000/- per month (Accountant, Ayush Pharmacist) to Rs. 29524/- per month (Psychiatric Social Worker); Staff Nurse (GNM) under NBSU and NHM gets Rs. 16564/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 400/- for General/Other Backward Class and Rs. 200/- for SC/ST candidates for each post, paid by demand draft in favour of District Health Society, Ramgarh.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for DHS Ramgarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form, attach the documents, demand draft, Indemnity Bond and a stamped envelope, and send it by registered post or speed post to Civil Surgeon cum Chief Medical Officer, (Chhattarmandu) Ramgarh-825101.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on marks in academic and technical examinations / Written Test / Skill Test / Interview, one or more as applicable, and the final merit list will be shown for one week in the Civil Surgeon/Deputy Commissioner office.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DHS Ramgarh job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is on contract for one year, which may be extended year by year on the basis of Annual Performance/Appraisal, and candidates must give an Indemnity Bond not to claim regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Who can apply, and what should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: Only local residents of Jharkhand can apply, and the envelope must show the Advertisement No., the post name and the programme name, otherwise the application will not be opened.
